name: p2party-server
description: Protocol-v5 signaling server for p2party WebRTC room meshes

scripts.check: bun run db:generate && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.format: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree > /dev/null && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 prettier --write --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.format:check: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree > /dev/null && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 prettier --check --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.build:linux: bun run db:generate && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --bytecode --target=bun-linux-x64-modern --format esm ./src/index.ts --outfile deploy/ansible/builds/p2party_linux_x64
scripts.build:linux:arm64: bun run db:generate && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --bytecode --target=bun-linux-arm64 --format esm ./src/index.ts --outfile deploy/ansible/builds/p2party_linux_arm64
scripts.build:macos: bun run db:generate && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --format esm ./src/index.ts --outfile deploy/ansible/builds/p2party_macos
scripts.build:windows: bun run db:generate && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap --bytecode --target=bun-windows-x64-modern --format esm ./src/index.ts --outfile deploy/ansible/builds/p2party_exe
